query:
WITH RECURSIVE playlist_tree AS (
                SELECT id, 0 AS depth
                FROM playlists
                WHERE id = $1
                UNION ALL
                SELECT p.id, pt.depth + 1
                FROM playlists p
                JOIN playlist_tree pt ON p.parent_id = pt.id
                WHERE p.room_id = $2
            )
            SELECT id AS "id!: PlaylistId", MAX(depth) AS depth
            FROM playlist_tree
            GROUP BY id
            ORDER BY MAX(depth) DESC, id
